name: ADDWF
description: Adds WREG to the byte in f. d selects whether the result is written to WREG (0) or f (1).

name: ADDWFC
short: Add WREG and Carry bit to f
description: Adds WREG, the byte in f, and the current Carry bit. d selects whether the result is written to WREG (0) or f (1).

name: ANDWF
description: Applies bitwise AND to WREG and the byte in f. d selects where the result is written.

name: CLRF
description: Writes zero to f and sets the Zero flag.

name: COMF
description: Inverts every bit of the byte in f. d selects whether the result is written to WREG (0) or f (1).

name: CPFSEQ
description: Compares f with WREG as unsigned bytes. If they are equal, the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: CPFSGT
short: Compare f with WREG, skip if >
description: Compares f with WREG as unsigned bytes. If f is greater than WREG, the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: CPFSLT
short: Compare f with WREG, skip if <
description: Compares f with WREG as unsigned bytes. If f is less than WREG, the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: DECF
description: Subtracts one from the byte in f. d selects whether the result is written to WREG (0) or f (1).

name: DECFSZ
description: Subtracts one from f and writes the result to WREG (d = 0) or f (d = 1). If the result is zero, the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: DCFSNZ
description: Subtracts one from f and writes the result to WREG (d = 0) or f (d = 1). If the result is not zero, the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: INCF
description: Adds one to the byte in f. d selects whether the result is written to WREG (0) or f (1).

name: INCFSZ
description: Adds one to f and writes the result to WREG (d = 0) or f (d = 1). If the result is zero, the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: INFSNZ
description: Adds one to f and writes the result to WREG (d = 0) or f (d = 1). If the result is not zero, the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: IORWF
description: Applies bitwise inclusive OR to WREG and the byte in f. d selects where the result is written.

name: MOVF
description: Copies the byte in f to WREG (d = 0) or writes it back to f (d = 1). The value is unchanged, but the Zero and Negative flags are updated.

name: MOVFF
operation: Contents of source fs → destination fd
encoding: 1100 ffff ffff ffff / 1111 ffff ffff ffff
description: Copies one byte from the full source file address fs to the full destination file address fd. The Bank Select Register is not needed for either address.

name: MOVWF
description: Copies the current WREG value into f. WREG itself is unchanged.

name: MULWF
description: Multiplies the unsigned bytes in WREG and f. The 16-bit product is stored in PRODH:PRODL.

name: NEGF
description: Replaces the byte in f with its two’s complement, equivalent to subtracting it from zero.

name: RLCF
description: Rotates the byte in f left through Carry. Its highest bit becomes the new Carry bit; the old Carry bit becomes the lowest bit of the result.

name: RLNCF
description: Rotates the byte in f left by one bit. Its highest bit wraps into the lowest bit; Carry is unchanged.

name: RRCF
description: Rotates the byte in f right through Carry. Its lowest bit becomes the new Carry bit; the old Carry bit becomes the highest bit of the result.

name: RRNCF
description: Rotates the byte in f right by one bit. Its lowest bit wraps into the highest bit; Carry is unchanged.

name: SETF
description: Writes FFh to f. No status flags are changed.

name: SUBFWB
short: Subtract f from WREG with borrow
description: Subtracts f and the borrow from WREG. A cleared Carry bit represents a borrow; d selects where the result is written.

name: SUBWF
description: Subtracts WREG from f. d selects whether the result is written to WREG (0) or f (1).

name: SUBWFB
short: Subtract WREG from f with borrow
description: Subtracts WREG and the borrow from f. A cleared Carry bit represents a borrow; d selects where the result is written.

name: SWAPF
description: Exchanges the upper and lower four bits of f. d selects whether the result is written to WREG (0) or f (1).

name: TSTFSZ
description: Tests whether f contains zero. If it does, the next instruction is skipped; f and status flags are unchanged.

name: XORWF
description: Applies bitwise exclusive OR to WREG and the byte in f. d selects where the result is written.

name: BCF
description: Clears bit b of f to zero. Other bits and status flags are unchanged.

name: BSF
description: Sets bit b of f to one. Other bits and status flags are unchanged.

name: BTFSC
short: Bit Test f, Skip if Clear
description: Tests bit b of f. If that bit is clear (0), the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: BTFSS
short: Bit Test f, Skip if Set
description: Tests bit b of f. If that bit is set (1), the next instruction is skipped; status flags are unchanged.

name: BTG
description: Toggles bit b of f: zero becomes one and one becomes zero. Other bits and status flags are unchanged.

name: BC
description: If Carry is set, branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BC. Otherwise, execution continues with that next instruction.

name: BN
description: If Negative is set, branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BN. Otherwise, execution continues with that next instruction.

name: BNC
description: If Carry is clear, branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BNC. Otherwise, execution continues with that next instruction.

name: BNN
description: If Negative is clear, branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BNN. Otherwise, execution continues with that next instruction.

name: BNOV
description: If Overflow is clear, branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BNOV. Otherwise, execution continues with that next instruction.

name: BNZ
description: If Zero is clear, branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BNZ. Otherwise, execution continues with that next instruction.

name: BOV
description: If Overflow is set, branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BOV. Otherwise, execution continues with that next instruction.

name: BRA
description: Always branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BRA.

name: BZ
description: If Zero is set, branches by the signed offset n relative to the instruction after BZ. Otherwise, execution continues with that next instruction.

name: CALL
operation: (PC) + 4 → TOS, k → PC<20:1>; if s = 1, (W) → WS, (STATUS) → STATUSS, (BSR) → BSRS
description: Pushes the return address onto the return stack and jumps to address k. With s = 1, WREG, STATUS, and BSR are also copied to their shadow registers for a fast return.

name: CLRWDT
description: Clears the Watchdog Timer and its postscaler, then sets the TO and PD status bits.

name: DAW
operation: Adjust WREG after packed BCD addition; carry may change
description: Adjusts WREG after adding packed decimal digits so its value represents two decimal digits. The Carry bit may change.

name: GOTO
description: Jumps directly to program address k. It does not push a return address.

name: NOP
description: Performs no operation; execution continues at the next instruction.

name: POP
description: Removes the top entry from the hardware return stack.

name: PUSH
short: Push PC + 2 onto the return stack
description: Pushes the address of the next instruction onto the hardware return stack.

name: RCALL
description: Pushes the address of the next instruction onto the return stack, then branches by the signed offset n from that address.

name: RESET
operation: Reset all registers and flags that are affected by a MCLR Reset.
description: Triggers a software device reset, affecting the same registers and flags as an MCLR Reset.

name: RETFIE
operation: (TOS) → PC, 1 → GIE/GIEH or PEIE/GIEL; if s = 1, (WS) → W, (STATUSS) → STATUS, (BSRS) → BSR, PCLATU, PCLATH are unchanged
short: Return from interrupt and re-enable interrupts
description: Returns to the address on the return stack and re-enables interrupts. With s = 1, WREG, STATUS, and BSR are restored from their shadow registers.

name: RETLW
operation: k → W, (TOS) → PC, PCLATU, PCLATH are unchanged
description: Loads the 8-bit literal k into WREG, then returns to the address on the return stack.

name: RETURN
operation: (TOS) → PC; if s = 1, (WS) → W, (STATUSS) → STATUS, (BSRS) → BSR, PCLATU, PCLATH are unchanged
description: Returns to the address on the return stack. With s = 1, WREG, STATUS, and BSR are restored from their shadow registers.

name: SLEEP
description: Enters Standby mode and clears the Watchdog Timer and its postscaler. The TO bit is set and the PD bit is cleared.

name: ADDLW
description: Adds the 8-bit literal k to WREG and writes the result back to WREG.

name: ANDLW
description: Applies bitwise AND to WREG and the 8-bit literal k, writing the result to WREG.

name: IORLW
description: Applies bitwise inclusive OR to WREG and the 8-bit literal k, writing the result to WREG.

name: LFSR
description: Loads the 12-bit literal k into the File Select Register selected by f (FSR0, FSR1, or FSR2).

name: MOVLB
operands: 0 ≤ k ≤ 255 (only k<3:0> is loaded into BSR)
description: Loads the 4-bit literal k into the Bank Select Register, selecting a bank for later file-register operations.

name: MOVLW
description: Loads the 8-bit literal k into WREG.

name: MULLW
description: Multiplies WREG by the unsigned 8-bit literal k. The 16-bit product is stored in PRODH:PRODL.

name: SUBLW
description: Subtracts WREG from the 8-bit literal k and writes the result to WREG.

name: XORLW
description: Applies bitwise exclusive OR to WREG and the 8-bit literal k, writing the result to WREG.

name: TBLRD*
operation: Read program memory byte into TABLAT; TBLPTR unchanged
description: Reads the program-memory byte addressed by TBLPTR into TABLAT. TBLPTR is unchanged.

name: TBLRD*+
operation: Read program memory byte into TABLAT; TBLPTR increases after transfer
description: Reads the program-memory byte addressed by TBLPTR into TABLAT, then increments TBLPTR.

name: TBLRD*-
operation: Read program memory byte into TABLAT; TBLPTR decreases after transfer
description: Reads the program-memory byte addressed by TBLPTR into TABLAT, then decrements TBLPTR.

name: TBLRD+*
operation: Read program memory byte into TABLAT; TBLPTR increases before transfer
description: Increments TBLPTR, then reads the program-memory byte at the new address into TABLAT.

name: TBLWT*
operation: Move TABLAT into a program-memory holding register; TBLPTR unchanged
description: Copies TABLAT to the program-memory write holding register selected by TBLPTR. TBLPTR is unchanged.

name: TBLWT*+
operation: Move TABLAT into a program-memory holding register; TBLPTR increases after transfer
description: Copies TABLAT to the program-memory write holding register selected by TBLPTR, then increments TBLPTR.

name: TBLWT*-
operation: Move TABLAT into a program-memory holding register; TBLPTR decreases after transfer
description: Copies TABLAT to the program-memory write holding register selected by TBLPTR, then decrements TBLPTR.

name: TBLWT+*
operation: Move TABLAT into a program-memory holding register; TBLPTR increases before transfer
description: Increments TBLPTR, then copies TABLAT to the program-memory write holding register at the new address.
